Status: REVIEWED — wave 9 complete, 7/7 slices green, pushed, PRs open (grade A−)

[2026-07-26, Review] Supersedes the BUILDING status below-dated 2026-07-26 morning: all seven round-1 builders finished green, the wave reviewer fixed three issues in place, and every final branch is pushed with a PR open (#6210–#6213, #6215–#6217). Round 2 (stw9-copy-honesty-mobile) dispatches after #6210 and #6212 merge. Full story in the Debrief section at the bottom.

The wish (verbatim)

I am missing a perfect Next demo - the search one - i need it to be perfect

Ground truth — what a stranger sees today (strategist, browser-verified 2026-07-26)

The Next search demo exists: site search-ember (template search-starter, kind node, theme ember) at https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/sites/search-ember/. It is live — and it is broken at the first beat of the journey:

  • First paint shows a red error box. "Search failed. search 404: document not found." The default engine (Indx) 404s through the site's own /api/find server route. Typing a query fails the same way. Switching to Postgres works (real hits) — but no stranger does that. The flat anonymous route on guerrilla serves indx fine (1073 hits for "deploy"), so the failure is inside the site's loopback path or its baked config — likely fixed by task-2e8da7ff6bd0b7c2 (loopback D3-b silent fallback, merged 07-18, one day AFTER the live deploy).
  • The websocket never connects. Zero websocket requests in the network log. "Instant-as-you-type over a Phoenix websocket" is false on the live demo; every keystroke rides the HTTP fallback.
  • The live deploy is nine days stale (2026-07-17) and predates the entire perf trio (#4130 ?fields= projection, #4144 scalar hit fields, #4189 WS fields allowlist — all 2026-07-18) plus the robustness wave that went to Astro. The perf fixes ARE in templates/search-starter/lib on origin/main (verified) — they simply never reached the live site.
  • Node sites never auto-redeploy. astro-search (static) rebuilt via content-auto on 07-21; search-ember (node) sits at trigger=manual 07-17 with content_bound=true on the SAME dataset. Either node auto-deploy is broken or something silently stopped it. Template merges trigger nothing either. The demo structurally rots.
  • The graph is a monochrome hairball with a broken legend. 3182 nodes render as an undifferentiated grey blob; the legend title "Barkpark documentation graph" overlaps the hint text (visible text collision); "constellation" it is not.
  • The corpus is dev exhaust. guerrilla production/default = 2705 tasks + 451 papers. Hits read like internal task titles. The reference-rich seed corpus the epic built (stw1-seed-corpus, entry type) is not what the demo binds. Zero geo → the map surface is presumably dead.
  • Residue gates: @barkpark/react npm preview.2 still unpublished (template rides file:./vendor/*.tgz — works, D4 dishonored); search-capstone site exists but was never deployed; the dashboard create-site modal (stw2-spa-create-site) is still open, so the demo cannot be spawned from the console.

Direction — the perfect Next flagship, experience-first, browser-proven, rot-proof

Define the stranger's demo journey as measurable beats and make every beat perfect on a LIVE canonical Next demo — then guard it against rot:

  1. Land — clean first paint, zero error states, a graph that reads as a constellation (type-colored, legible legend, tuned for the real corpus density), honest copy.
  2. Type — instant-as-you-type over the websocket (actually connected), both engines working, ~20KB frames, sub-100ms perceived.
  3. Click a hit — the master-split opens the document alongside search; PortableDoc detail renders gorgeously.
  4. Explore — graph node clicks land, facets work, no dead surfaces (the map either has geo to show or does not appear).
  5. Stay perfect — the demo redeploys when its template or content changes (fix node content-auto; add a template-change trigger or scheduled freshness), and a repeatable browser-level smoke harness asserts the journey beats so render-blindness (task-3b60cf7c4fc6bd04's class of miss) ends for the Next edition.

Root-cause first: the indx loopback 404 and the dead WS must be explained against the DEPLOYED env before slicing — if they are box-state rather than template bugs, the fix lands in different code. The demo-corpus question (curated seed dataset vs dogfood exhaust) is decided at Decide with survey evidence in hand. Kinsta/Vercel is the bar: a stranger should feel the product is expensive within ten seconds.

The direction debate

Candidate A — "Redeploy and patch." Ops wave: root-cause indx + WS, redeploy search-ember, verify, done. Honest but small: leaves the hairball graph, the dead map, the dev-exhaust corpus, no guard against re-rot, no browser harness. The demo would be working, not perfect — and it demonstrably rotted once already; it would rot again.

Candidate B — "Experience-first, browser-proven, rot-proof" (WINNER). The journey-beats direction above. Wins because the wish says perfect, the epic's own vision paragraph defines what perfect looks like (constellation graph, instant WS search, pixel-perfect PortableDoc), and the browser session proved the gap is experience-wide, not one bug. It also converts this wave's QA into a permanent harness, which is the only thing that stops wave N+1 from rediscovering wave N's breakage.

Candidate C — "Demo as product funnel." Fold in the dashboard create-site picker (stw2-spa-create-site), README, thumbnails, npm publish — perfect the path TO the demo. Real value, but the wish points at the demo itself, and the funnel work is console-SPA territory that starves the experience work. Deferred to the next wave; the npm preview.2 human gate gets re-surfaced as a standing ask, not wave scope.

Sharpest attack on the winner: "perfect" is unbounded — polish scope-creeps, and the corpus decision (curated vs dogfood) could churn the graph/map/detail work. Absorbed three ways: (1) the journey beats are a closed, measurable list — first-paint clean, WS connected, N-keystroke latency, every-hit-detail-renders, graph-legible, no-dead-surface; (2) the corpus decision is a Decide-phase decision gated on survey evidence, and slices are cut so engine fixes are corpus-independent; (3) if root causes turn out to be box-state, the wave still ships the harness + freshness guard, which are corpus- and cause-independent.

Survey plan (16 assignments, Opus fleet)

  • indx-loopback-404 — trace /api/find → loopback for engine=indx; why "document not found" when the flat route works; did #4174-era fixes cover it; does a redeploy fix it? Determines whether the first-paint fix is template, engine, or box-state.
  • ws-never-connects — what bakes NEXT_PUBLIC_BARKPARK_WS_URL/TOKEN on the managed node deploy path; inspect the deployed env on guerrilla. The "instant" claim hangs on it.
  • node-content-auto-silent — why search-ember never auto-redeploys while astro-search does. The rot mechanism.
  • template-freshness-guard — design space for template-merge → flagship redeploy. The anti-rot slice.
  • graph-at-scale — bp-graph.js at 3182 nodes: color modes, caps, legend overlap bug, theme parity. Constellation vs hairball.
  • demo-copy-audit — every string a stranger reads; where each lives; suggest/popular chips source. Copy is part of perfect.
  • corpus-strategy — what the seed corpus renders like vs dogfood; can a curated dataset live on guerrilla; doc_type today. Biggest experience lever, needs evidence.
  • map-surface-truth — when the map appears; behavior with zero geo. No dead surfaces.
  • detail-page-qa — click hits of every type live; vendored tgz staleness; block coverage. The PortableDoc promise.
  • master-split-nav — split view, URL state, back/forward, direct-load on the live basePath host. The navigation beats.
  • browser-smoke-harness — prior art + cheapest repeatable journey-assert harness for CI or post-deploy. Ends render-blindness.
  • keystroke-payload-proof — verify the perf trio applies to the NEXT edition's WS and loopback paths post-redeploy. Perf beat evidence.
  • mobile-responsive — the live demo on phone viewport; responsive gaps. Kinsta/Vercel bar includes mobile.
  • prior-live-proof-art — W3/W5 Next live-proof history; why search-capstone was never deployed; what acceptance existed. Avoid re-learning.
  • flagship-identity — naming/theme/dataset options for the canonical demo site; console visibility. The demo needs one canonical address.
  • engine-toggle-ux — default engine choice, failure fallback UX, engine badge honesty. First-interaction resilience.

Ledger links

Epic task: search-template-epic-goal (wave_status + wave_paper stamped). Charter: .claude/workflows/bp-search-template-charter.md (read at strategize; md5 matches origin/main). Live evidence: browser session against /sites/search-ember/ 2026-07-26; CP sites listing; flat-route probes.

Survey digest (Digest phase, 2026-07-26)

16/16 surveyors reported; every load-bearing claim below carries file:line or live-probe evidence in the survey reports. Premise smoke ran clean: all cited code sites confirmed on origin/main; charter D11/D12/D13/D38/D43/D44/D45/D47 git-shown and read for coverage.

Established per journey beat

  • LAND — the indx 404 is a double-scoped URL: find-search.ts:111 blindly concats ${API_URL}${SCOPE} while the slot env already bakes a pre-scoped BARKPARK_API_URL=…/w/default/p/default. Curling the doubled URL reproduces the exact live error body. The file has ONE commit ever — redeploy alone provably cannot fix first paint. Fix owner: template origin-derivation (the guard already exists in graph.ts:156 and is documented in astro's bp.ts:57-58). Risk: flat-route indx may return NULL facets (prior measurement) — fix could trade the red box for an empty facet rail.
  • TYPE — the websocket is dead code in the shipped bundle: unreplaced process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BARKPARK_WS_* reads proven in the live chunk; next.config.mjs never derives them and the deploy env allowlist (closed, 400s unknown keys, three layers) can never carry them. Astro already ships the fix (astro.config.mjs:64-65); charter D38/D43/D47 ratify derivation from allowlisted vars with a public-read token — the Next config is the lone unfixed surface. Also unreplaced WORKSPACE/PROJECT means WS_SCOPE would be default:default regardless. Perf: #4189 (WS fields allowlist) IS in the Next tree; #4130/#4144 never reached the Next HTTP loopback — a ~2-line fields= addition removes the full-envelope upstream hop that is the Next latency problem (browser bytes were never the Next problem: hits are shaped server-side).
  • CLICK — 100% dead live: every detail type, including four verified-real slugs, soft-404s at HTTP 200; PortableDoc has never been exercised on this deployment. mediaAsset alone takes the error branch (sharpest root-cause probe). The vendored @barkpark/react tgz wears a FALSE version number (preview.1 + PortableDoc, unlike real npm preview.1), is 3 source commits stale (missing the #6114 list-item fix), and the npm human gate — while still open — does NOT block the live demo (file: pins).
  • EXPLORE — the master-split shell works (browser-proven on engine=postgres: click-through, rail survival, back/forward, deep-load, honest facets) — slice the data layer, not the layout. Graph: legend overlap = TWO independent overlays claiming the same corner; monochrome is a hard-coded fullColor:false (one-line lever); vendored bp-graph.js is 19 lines stale (no setTheme — D11 dead live); the sim is FROZEN unconverged (O(n²), 40ms settle budget, then alpha hard-zeroed) at ~1804 nodes — the live count is ~1804, not 3182; the client ignores the server's truncated flag. Finder and graph read DIFFERENT corpora (graph fetch has no types= filter). Map: unreachable by construction (manifest lacks the env keys) but the manifest description advertises it, and the fallback silently renders fabricated Norwegian cafés — hide, don't seed geo.
  • STAY PERFECT — content-auto is structurally impossible for kind=node (registry.ex:4206 mints the webhook secret only for kind=="static"; no backfill path exists; content_bound is projected from the READ token and lies). Templates-only merges deploy NOTHING (deploy.yml job filters omit templates — 2 of the 3 perf-trio commits deployed nothing; vacuous green). The box already has a content-true template digest (provisioner.ex:198-217) — the CP only needs to ask; build_id folds the box sha so an unforced enqueue self-dedupes. Trigger whitelist is closed (manual|content-auto). Build-storm trap: content_rev fails OPEN to random — a periodic sweep must skip that branch (07-18 incident precedent).
  • Copy/identity/corpus — hero copy env seam is DEAD on the managed path (BUILD_ALLOW has zero NEXT_PUBLIC_*): the hardcoded fallbacks ARE the copy. Two contradictory taglines ship simultaneously; "documentation graph" is false ×3; the Popular chips are a shared telemetry pool polluted by agent queries (this wave's own surveyor queries appeared in recent[]). Identity: rename is IMPOSSIBLE (PATCH accepts only theme+doc_type); dataset binding is create-time only — a curated corpus forces minting a new site, collapsing the corpus and identity questions into one Decide call. D13 (smoke-verified) rules flat /v1/graph reads the DEFAULT workspace only. D45 shows BARKPARK_DOC_TYPE=paper on guerrilla was deliberate — correcting the survey framing "the decision was never made". doc_type is settable but never serialized back (blind surface). search-capstone is live-and-ORPHANED (no CP deployment row; no delete verb exists).
  • Engine UX — indxUnavailable is mathematically dead code (engineUsed always equals requested engine); the SSR seed swallows failures to null; the route default (postgres) OPPOSES the client default (indx, 4 hardcodes, no constant); the red box renders raw upstream strings in a <pre>. web/ is a drifted third copy of the whole finder (no #4189 either) — every fix must name all three trees or re-fork.
  • Harness — the repo already owns a zero-dep CDP transport CI-proven at 5.9s (cssom-parity job); task-3b60cf7c4fc6bd04 prescribes puppeteer (superseded) and is astro-scoped. WS-connected must be asserted at the CDP Network layer (the failure path is deliberately silent); soft-404 means status-code assertions are worthless — assert rendered markers ([data-nav-result], bp-paper-surface, bp-doc-id). Two layers needed: CI (source facts) + scheduled live-URL (deployment facts — the four live failures are ALL deployment facts).
  • Mobile — structurally sound (no hscroll, gate works, overlay degrades); defects: off-screen dead fallback, bp-table sideways-scrolls the whole article (CSS lives in the vendored pkg — SDK-side blast radius), sub-44px tap targets, ragged control strip. Inherits the indx 404 unchanged.

Coverage map — checked and NOT found (absences are decisions-in-waiting)

  • No rename path for sites; no backfill/re-register path for content webhooks (create_site is the only caller); no template-driven or scheduled deploy trigger; no node case in the webhook-registration tests.
  • No Next-edition test, smoke, or CI workflow of ANY kind; no fields= on the Next loopback; no DEFAULT_ENGINE constant; no truncation honesty in the graph client; no /map route (map unreachable by construction).
  • No repo reference to the literal slug search-ember; no wave-8 paper exists; no bp cloud site list/delete/rename verbs (delete DOES exist server-side per identity report — CLI verb roster differs between reports; verify round settles it).
  • Corners no surveyor reached: search_channel.ex full join-auth read (the ONE unread load-bearing file); live guerrilla DB rows (sites table: content_webhook_secret_encrypted, doc_type); box webhook rows; the guerrilla box checkout's git sha; where the CP composes the scoped BARKPARK_API_URL; whether astro's WS actually connects live; charter file unread by 5 surveyors who flagged it.

Contradictions with the strategic direction (absorbed)

The "3182-node hairball" is not the Next count (~1804, under the 2000 budget — likely astro or nodes+edges); the "loopback 404" premise was wrong (no loopback exists in the Next template — it is a double-scope bug); "corpus is 2705 tasks" was wrong (the finder serves papers; the graph shows everything — the mismatch is itself a finding); and the implicit "redeploy first" framing is falsified — template fixes must land BEFORE any redeploy matters.

Verify plan (in flight)

Eight verifiers, launched from this digest. Each must RUN its proof, not read it.

  1. ws-join-proof (opus) — handshake guerrilla /socket/websocket with the REAL slot token (ssh + curl), attempt the SearchChannel join, read search_channel.ex join auth end-to-end, confirm the token is public-read-clamped, check astro's live bundle WS state.
  2. indx-flat-truth (opus) — curl the flat search route as the site token: indx facets present or NULL? &fields= projection: bytes, ms, does it preserve the content.* keys normalizeHit reads?
  3. graph-truth (opus) — authenticated /v1/graph: node count, per-node fields (any kind?), truncated flag; read graph_corpus workspace resolution to re-confirm D13 on today's main.
  4. detail-route-cause (opus) — compose get-document.ts's exact upstream URLs with the slot env and curl them; explain the mediaAsset asymmetry; localize the soft-404 (proxy vs Next).
  5. cp-row-and-env (opus) — ssh guerrilla: sites rows (secret NULL? doc_type? theme), box webhook rows, box checkout sha vs perf-trio commits; find where the CP composes the scoped BARKPARK_API_URL; webhook-create name uniqueness.
  6. freshness-gates (opus) — run the deploy.yml filter regexes against the perf-trio file lists (prove the vacuous green); run the content_publish_receiver tests; trace whether node deploys exercise the provisioner digest.
  7. vendor-rebuild (opus) — pnpm build+pack @barkpark/react, prove the fresh tgz carries PortableDoc + the #6114 fix; diff bp-graph.js snapshots; locate the bp-table overflow fix surface.
  8. corpus-identity-call (fable) — the ONE judgment: curated-seed vs dogfood vs hybrid, coupled with mint-new-site identity, graph/finder corpus unification, chips partition, and content-auto blast radius — a recommendation memo for Decide with every claim anchored.

Verify round — proven, refuted, corrected

Eight verifiers, all reported; coverage deficit: none (survey and verify). Highlights, trust order proofs > facts:

  • ws-join-proof — the WS fix LANDS but needs a THIRD variable: the real slot token joins search:default:default:production and returns count=670 over the socket; but the Next fallback topic search:default:default:docs joins green and returns count=0 — a two-var fix looks fixed while returning nothing. Token clamp proven live (write 403, admin 403); channel hard-codes perspective: :published. Digest correction: WS_SCOPE was NOT the wrong variable — DATASET is.
  • indx-flat-truth — Indx is UNCONFIGURED on guerrilla (zero INDX_* env, no plugin_settings row): every engine=indx reply is Postgres-with-recovery (recovery: typo_widen/drop_tokens on every query), facets null on EVERY route, worse ranking. The site's public-read token 403s the FLAT search route (200 scoped) — the LAND fix must stay scoped, single-scoped. fields= without blocks kills snippets and doubles server ms; with blocks: 2.7MB→732KB and fastest. BONUS LEAK re-proven: public-read token reads a draft via scoped search + perspective=drafts → stw7-backlog-drafts-clamp-gap escalated to p0 (D60).
  • graph-truth — 1803 nodes / 987 edges (strategist's 3182 refuted); type is a real 6-value facet; TYPE_HEX lacks tag/command/metric/session (14% slate if colored naively); truncated:false is a HALF-TRUTH (per-type limit:1000 silently drops ~2100 tasks); types= does not exist; D13 re-proven structurally (flat graph pins to Default workspace). Graph DATA on the stale deploy is live — only code is stale.
  • detail-route-cause — CLICK is NOT the LAND bug and NOT dead: papers with blocks render PortableDoc live (bp-paper-surface + 32 bp-table); ~2.5% body_html-only papers degrade to a raw MetaCard field dump; mediaAsset is a guaranteed red panel (list-op 404 throws); every notFound() returns HTTP 200 (loading.tsx Suspense boundary commits the status; layout comment falsified on Next 16.2.4). Caddy exonerated.
  • v-cp-row-and-env — CP DB truth: search-ember kind=node doc_type=paper theme=ember, NO content secret, trigger=manual 07-17; the scoped-URL composer is deploy.ex:371 scoped_api_url; the box checkout ALREADY carries the perf trio (redeploy is a trigger problem) but the on-box template bytes still carry the LAND bug — redeploy alone ships the same red box. NEW: all 8 site-autodeploy webhooks auto-disabled (6 orphans of deleted sites); receiver healthy today — the disable is a stale latch.
  • freshness-gates — vacuous green CONFIRMED: templates/** triggers deploy.yml but neither job regex matches (perf trio: 2 of 3 commits deployed nothing) — THIRD instance of the two-drifting-lists class. Node deploys DO run the provisioner digest path (20/20 tests incl. node cases). NEW TRAP: build_id has no template-digest input → an unforced enqueue no-ops on a template-only change until the CI fix advances code_rev; forced schedules storm (per-tick nonce; content_rev fails open to random).
  • vendor-rebuild — refresh is cheap and correct but the obvious recipe ships vacuous green: npm pack emits uninstallable workspace:^; tarball swap without lockfile regen is EINTEGRITY cold / green-but-OLD-bytes warm (proven). Working recipe proven end-to-end; mobile bp-table overflow fix is SDK-side, already on main, delivered by the re-vendor alone. bp-graph delta = exactly the 19-line setTheme hunk; api==web canonical, both templates identically stale.
  • corpus-identity-call — delivered facts/proofs with an EMPTY findings memo (recorded honestly); the decision was made from its proof rows + graph-truth + cp-row-and-env: dataset binding create-time-only (PATCH takes only theme+doc_type), delete verb EXISTS on origin/main (installed bp stale), /v1/graph?dataset= genuinely scopes, chips partition per dataset, production chips pool is dev exhaust live, non-task subgraph is 728 nodes with 4 edges.

Open risks carried into the wave: phoenix.js longpoll fallback path unproven under Caddy; CP build command (npm ci vs install) unverified in cloud/lib; the soft-404 fix mechanism is diagnosed but the precise remedy is a builder-proven hypothesis; core tarball delta unaudited (gate: export-surface diff).

Decisions (D49–D60) — mirrored from the charter (34e58ae4a)

  • D49 LAND = template-side origin derivation, single-scoped, token kept (flat 403s public-read).
  • D50 Default engine POSTGRES via one DEFAULT_ENGINE const; indx gets a real one-retry fallback; raw-<pre> error box dies.
  • D51 HTTP loopback fields= WITH blocks.
  • D52 WS arm = THREE inlined values via next.config env mapping (URL, token, dataset[+ws/proj]); acceptance is count>0, never "connected".
  • D53 CLICK = body_html render branch + MetaCard blob guard; media types leave KNOWN_TYPES; honest 404 by dropping the detail Suspense boundary.
  • D54 Graph goes constellation client-side at today's scale (color+legend+convergence+setTheme, all four copies synced); server graph honesty is backlog with the coupled-ceilings trap documented.
  • D55 KEEP dogfood corpus + KEEP search-ember this wave (one-way coupling: curated ⇒ new site ⇒ empty graph outside Default); chips curated client-side; identity is backlog.
  • D56 Node content-auto: widen mint gate + idempotent register-by-name + dereg on delete; fleet webhook backfill is a sequenced post-merge lead op.
  • D57 Freshness = deploy.yml filter truth (with a paths↔regex consistency assertion) THEN a scheduled UNFORCED template-auto sweep that skips content_rev fail-open. Never force on a schedule.
  • D58 Vendor refresh = pnpm pack + lockfile regen, gated on CONTENT assertions (itemInlines, overflow-x), never install exit codes.
  • D59 Journey smoke on the zero-dep CDP transport (re-specs task-3b60cf7c4fc6bd04 off puppeteer); WS asserted at the transport; CI + scheduled live modes.
  • D60 stw7-backlog-drafts-clamp-gap escalated to p0 (live-reproduced with the demo's own shipped token). HIGH-FLIP-RISK security judgment — independent second review owed before its merge.

Debrief (Review phase, 2026-07-26) — the wave seals

Grade: A−. Seven slices built, adversarially reviewed, gate-passing, pushed, PRs open. Every root cause the verify round proved is closed template- or CP-side; what remains open is exactly the post-merge live seal the plan always reserved for the lead. The minus: nothing here is live-proven yet (all seven proofs rode local runs, stubs, or synthetic fixtures — the plan's own design), and the wave shipped one real cross-slice defect that review had to catch.
